articles.title: Reliability-weighted patch learning for synthetic CT reconstruction in head and neck adaptive radiotherapy
articles.summary: This study introduces HQ-PatchNet, a computationally efficient method for daily CBCT-guided online adaptive radiotherapy. The approach improves CBCT-to-synthetic CT image quality, supporting future clinical utility in adaptive treatment workflows.

articles.title: Fully automated AI-based quantification of tumour volume on PSMA PET-CT images is associated with overall survival
articles.summary: Researchers demonstrated that fully automated AI-derived total lesion volume from PSMA PET-CT imaging is associated with overall survival in prostate cancer patients. The findings support the potential for AI-based tumor quantification as a prognostic biomarker in clinical practice.

articles.title: A Novel Medical Conformity Index (MCI) Integrating Spatial Distance and Target Volume Weighting for Enhanced Radiotherapy Plan Evaluation
articles.summary: This study introduces a new medical conformity index that improves upon traditional geometric metrics by incorporating clinical considerations and spatial distance. The proposed index provides a more robust method for evaluating the quality of radiotherapy treatment plans.

articles.title: Comparative Analysis of Arc Geometrical Configurations and Jaw Tracking for Peripheral Low-Dose Bath in Whole Breast VMAT
articles.summary: This research investigates how different arc geometries and jaw tracking techniques affect the low-dose radiation bath in volumetric modulated arc therapy for breast cancer. The findings provide practical insights for minimizing radiation exposure to surrounding healthy tissues.

articles.title: Preoperative Contrast-Enhanced CT-Based Three-Dimensional Fractal Analysis of Automatically Segmented Tumors for Predicting PD-L1 Expression in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
articles.summary: This study explores the use of 3D fractal analysis on preoperative CT imaging to non-invasively predict PD-L1 expression in hepatocellular carcinoma. Such imaging biomarkers may help characterize tumor heterogeneity and guide immunotherapy decisions.

articles.title: Impact of extended field-of-view on image quality and stopping power ratio in proton therapy dose calculation
articles.summary: This study evaluates the impact of using extended fields-of-view during CT simulation on image quality and proton stopping power ratio accuracy. The analysis is essential for ensuring precise dose calculations when scanning large anatomy or immobilization devices.

articles.title: High-dose reirradiation of in-field recurrence lung cancer in the THOrax (RETHO): toxicity analysis of a prospective trial
articles.summary: This prospective trial demonstrates the feasibility of high-dose reirradiation for recurrent lung cancer while managing cumulative doses to organs at risk. Toxicity analysis showed no severe esophageal or spinal cord complications, supporting the clinical safety of this approach.

articles.title: Pre-treatment machine learning prediction of local failure and time to local failure after Gamma Knife radiosurgery for radioresistant brain metastases
articles.summary: This research utilizes machine learning to predict local treatment failure in radioresistant brain metastases following radiosurgery. The model offers potential for improved patient risk stratification and customized follow-up strategies.

articles.title: Real world clinical outcomes of deep learning based versus manual proton therapy planning for oropharyngeal cancer
articles.summary: This matched cohort study found no significant difference in oncological outcomes or side effects between deep learning-based intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) and manual planning for oropharyngeal cancer. The findings support the clinical implementation of DL-based planning for these patients.

articles.title: Gaussian process regression of HDR prostate biopsy dose for improved modelling of localization-induced uncertainty
articles.summary: Researchers developed a Gaussian process regression framework to better account for localization-induced uncertainty in HDR prostate brachytherapy. This approach provides a spatially correlated model that offers a more robust basis for quality assurance and future dose-response analysis compared to voxelwise methods.

articles.title: Treatment plan quality comparison between ZAP-Axon( ) Krylov optimizer and Leksell Gamma Knife( ) Lightning optimizer for brain metastasis
articles.summary: This study compared the performance of two clinical optimizers for brain metastasis treatment planning. Findings suggest that while both are effective for large lesions, the Krylov optimizer demonstrates superior performance for small brain metastasis lesions.

articles.title: Mapping the evolution of spatially fractionated radiation therapy: A comprehensive bibliometric analysis
articles.summary: This bibliometric analysis examines the convergence of various spatially fractionated radiation therapy (SFRT) modalities into a unified research domain. It highlights the need for standardized clinical protocols and integration with emerging technologies like FLASH radiotherapy.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: ASTRO has released updated clinical guidelines regarding the implementation of shorter-course radiation therapy regimens for patients with localized prostate cancer. These updates aim to standardize best practices for hypofractionated treatment protocols in clinical settings.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has announced the treatment of the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, which investigates the use of ConformalFLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer. This trial marks a significant milestone in evaluating the clinical application of high-dose-rate FLASH radiotherapy technology.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space for patients and caregivers
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has expanded its clinical facilities by opening a new wellness space dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers during treatment. This development aims to enhance the patient experience at the regional proton therapy center.

articles.title: BayCare opens proton therapy center at Tampa's St. Joseph’s Hospital
articles.summary: BayCare has officially opened a new $33 million proton therapy center at St. Joseph’s Hospital in Tampa. The facility expands regional access to precise radiation therapy for patients in the area.

articles.title: Medicare change could cost standalone proton therapy centers millions
articles.summary: Proposed Medicare pricing changes threaten the financial viability of standalone proton therapy centers, potentially reducing revenue by nearly 30% compared to hospital-based facilities. Industry advocates warn that this policy could limit patient access and hinder future development of proton therapy infrastructure.
